At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Process Technician (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 203653

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Operational proficiency of clean processing equipment and wafer metrology tools

 * Along with engineering team, prepare equipment and execute test plans

 * Analyze and interpret data to draw inferences and make recommendations

 * Perform baseline qualifications of lab tools, identify problems, and work with appropriate team to resolve issues

 * Assist process engineers in execution, data collection and test reporting of customer demos

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * Completed technical education with a focus on Chemistry (LAP with experience/HTL/Chemical College)

 * 2+ years of applicable experience, preferably in semiconductor/electronics industry

 * Familiarity with working in a chemical laboratory

 * Good problem solving and data analysis skills

 * Good communication skills and ability to write engineering test reports, including analysis, conclusions and follow-up actions

 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

 * Ability to work in a team

A valid work permit for Austria is required for this position.

WHAT WE ARE OFFERING

This position is subject to the Austrian Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) for Employees in the Metal Technology Industry in the occupation group D-E depending on educational background. A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year. 

The candidate will be hired through a third party agency.

WORKING HOURS

Flexitime model 38,5 hours/week, Core hours (Mo-Th 9-15, Fr 9-11:30)

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Ex Commercial Founder (m/f/d) Your Role

As Ex Commercial Founder at fonio, you own one of our products. You're not just shaping the roadmap; you're accountable for the commercial success of the product. Strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and growth all sit with you.

You'll operate like a mini-CEO for your product: making the calls, running the experiments, and carrying the numbers. You won't do it alone: you're paired with a technical counterpart and together you own the product.

What you'll do

 * Own a product - from strategy and roadmap to go-to-market and revenue

 * Define positioning, pricing, and the commercial strategy for your product

 * Work directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship and grow fast

 * Own the metrics that matter - adoption, retention, and revenue - and be accountable for them

 * Run discovery: talk to customers, validate problems, and decide what gets built

What We Offer

 * Up to €150.000 OTE + equity.

 * On-site in Vienna, Munich, Barcelona or London - relocation package to Vienna if needed.

 * Real ownership of a fonio product: you get to essentially work like an entrepreneur inside of fonio.

 * Maximum autonomy - you run your product like your own company.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

What You Bring

 * Demonstrated track record as a founder or commercial owner - you've built and launched a B2B SaaS product & owned it end to end from the commercial side.

 * Strong commercial instinct: you think in terms of markets, customers, and revenue

 * Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and no predefined structure

 * Sharp analytical thinking paired with a bias for execution

 * Excellent communication in English; German is a strong plus given our DACH focus

 * Bonus: experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, or voice technology
